heading_convention: degrees clockwise from true north that the model +Y axis is turned

derivation.anchor: origin_longitude/latitude from the package georeference.json: the state-plane origin E 3,117,000 / N 10,069,000 ft (EPSG:6578), converted by the package author.
derivation.heading: Model +Y is state-plane grid north. Grid north leans clockwise from true north by the Texas Central grid convergence at this longitude, computed here as 1.338 degrees.
derivation.ground_offset: Model z = 0 is NAVD88 100 m. The elevation tiles give 142.6 m at the origin, so the model is sunk by the difference and the tunnels sit at true depth below the map plane. Ground rises to the north-east along the route, so the depth reads shallow there.
derivation.scale: Model metres are surface (ground) metres already; no scale change.

drainage.accuracy: Route and shaft positions from 2024 TxDOT contract drawings; the package calls the station-anchored route "survey check required". Metres, not tens of metres.

derivation.anchor: Centroid of the existing Austin Convention Center building in OpenStreetMap (way 187392350). The model pivot is its "approximate site center" and the proposal fills the same block.
derivation.heading: Model +Y is downtown-grid north. Measured as the bearing of Trinity Street between Cesar Chavez and 4th in OpenStreetMap: 17.87 degrees (the package estimated 17).
derivation.ground_offset: Model z = 0 is ground at the site.

convention-center.accuracy: Package: "approximate visual registration only". Expect the footprint to be off by up to a few tens of metres against the real block.

derivation.anchor: Midpoint of where the line of East 41st Street (joined across the highway) crosses the I-35 mainlane carriageways in OpenStreetMap (4 crossings averaged). The package pivot is "the approximate future 41st Street crossing center".
derivation.heading: Model +Y runs along the corridor. Mean bearing of the mainlanes at the crossing: 27.95 degrees.
derivation.ground_offset: Model z = 0 is the deck top, at street grade; the depressed highway sits at -10 m in the model.

i35-stitches.accuracy: Deck extents were traced from a presentation raster at 0.46 m per pixel; the package has no survey control. Tens of metres.

derivation.anchor: The OpenStreetMap node(s) shared by Trinity Street and East Cesar Chavez Street (1 found, averaged). This settles the package's two geocode candidates 56 m apart.
derivation.heading: Model +Y follows Trinity towards 3rd Street. Bearing of Trinity north of the anchor in OpenStreetMap: 17.99 degrees (the package estimated 18.01).
derivation.ground_offset: Model z = 0 is the lake at 428 ft (130.5 m). Street grade at the anchor from the elevation tiles is 142.6 m, so the model is sunk by the difference: streets on the map plane, the lake surface below it, the rail deck above.

lady-bird-rail.accuracy: Alignment traced from the FEIS conceptual plan sheets at 0.23 m per pixel. Tens of metres.

derivation.anchor: The package has no coordinates at all. Taken as the centroid of the Barbara Jordan Terminal footprint in OpenStreetMap (way 183977275) moved 308 m towards the airfield, perpendicular to the terminal's long axis: 308 m is the distance between the concourse and the terminal stand-in inside the model itself.
derivation.heading: Terminal long axis from OpenStreetMap: 88.13 degrees. Model +Y points at the terminal, so the heading is 358.13.

aus-concourse-b.accuracy: Conceptual: "no surveyed pivot or reliable georeferencing recovered". The position is a documented guess from the terminal footprint, not a site plan. Expect 50 m or more.
